You are one of 5 pirates digging for one buried treasure on a 15 by 15 grid. Each pirate gets 50 turns. Digging up the treasure opens a cave on its square, and only a pirate standing there is told. A pirate on the open cave can enter it, which uses its turn and takes it out of the game for good; the square holds one pirate at a time. Your crew scores 100 for every pirate that gets into the cave, plus 10 for each turn it had left after going in.
That score is shared: every pirate gets the crew's score, not its own. One pirate in the cave alone is a poor result; all 5 of you in the cave, as early as possible, is the best one. So split the search between you, and whoever finds the treasure should tell the others exactly where it is on the scroll before going in.
